responsibility: This generator script creates the AArch64 builtin-iterator header from iterators.md. It parses define_mode_iterator declarations, strips conditions and formatting, and emits BUILTIN_<ITERATOR> macros that expand into VAR<N> builtin-definition forms over the iterator’s mode list, so the SIMD builtin tables can reuse the machine-description iterator sets when generating intrinsic declarations and mappings.
